scope: Future controller behavior and capacity investigation only. This is not an execution manifest or a change to accepted experimental evidence.
controller_changes: Native deadlines preserve completed usage/model events and explicitly mark incomplete accounting. Only an interrupted, unterminated final JSONL record may be truncated.
A compiler deadline produces UNKNOWN unless an earlier valid static refutation exists. Attempted calls and completed native calls remain distinct.
Missing or unreadable deliverables are independent unmet-goal evidence; Docker and other infrastructure errors remain harness errors.
Intermediate tool errors do not override independent goal verification. Record exact call-limit and execution-deadline reasons, and distinguish incomplete tool calls from nonzero process exits.
An MCP server cannot restart over an existing event log and reset its tool-call budget.
Missing accounting never implies zero usage. Preserve stage outcomes and explicit measurement errors if receipt aggregation fails; refuse paid reruns of retained measurements.
Future native child environments explicitly set NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1, and receipts record that policy.

cache_policy.future_native_sessions: Compile caching disabled in the private environment for both the configuration probe and SDK process.
cache_policy.verification: The regression failed before the provider change. Six actual-client loopback tests then passed and found no node-compile-cache directory in any private session.
cache_policy.accepted_pilot: Existing files, metadata and timings are unchanged. Existing compile caches were not removed.
cache_policy.latency_disclosure: Cache policy can affect client startup time. Record this implementation amendment in a future freeze and distinguish its timings from the earlier pilot; do not silently relabel old timings.

hypothetical_per_trial_xz.method: Stream sorted non-cache file bytes through a separate fresh default LZMA/XZ compressor per paired trial; scale the twenty-trial sum by 7190/20.
hypothetical_per_trial_xz.interpretation: Promising estimate, not an available transparent storage path or a full-study capacity guarantee.

windows_transparent_compression_probe.compression: Windows compact.exe /C /EXE:LZX on private copies outside the clone
windows_transparent_compression_probe.interpretation: Windows LZX is not XZ. Reported file sizes exclude filesystem metadata and other overhead. Even this projection exceeds current free space before a system reserve.

projection_excludes: New public task inputs and runtime dependencies
Additional retries and larger unreviewed workflows
A safe reserve for the shared system volume
capacity_investigation.decision: No full-study launch on the current volume. Future cache disabling removes the dominant disposable footprint, but current raw retention still projects to 7.83 GB before reserves. Do not equate the hypothetical XZ stream with an implemented retention method or delete originals to meet the estimate.

paper.reason: No new experimental measurements; existing Figure 3 correctly reports coverage rather than full-cohort performance.
